product_one_liner.value: Rivo automatically moves consumers’ idle checking-account cash into short-term U.S. Treasuries and returns funds ahead of bills, helping households earn on cash without switching banks.

pricing_page.notes: No dedicated pricing page or pricing navigation link was found; fees are nevertheless publicly disclosed in the FAQ and fee-explainer blog post.

named_customers.notes: No qualifying customers/case-studies page or matching G2/Capterra listing was found, and no two named customers could be verified. Investors and financial partners were excluded.

employee_band.notes: No supported employee count fits the permitted bands, which start at 11–20.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog contains consumer-finance education and product/company posts, not two engineer-authored articles about building the product.

public_docs.notes: The public support material found is a single FAQ page, not a multi-article documentation site or help center.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: No public careers page or live job board was located. Historical recruiting posts do not establish a currently open AI/ML role.

model_provider.notes: No named model or provider was found in the public product material, FAQ, security explanation, blog or privacy policy. The FAQ mentions a Trust Center/subprocessor list, but no readable public list was located.

compliance_certs.notes: Public claim only: the FAQ says “are SOC 2 compliant”; the homepage describes “SOC 2 compliant infrastructure.” No independent audit report was verified.

last_funding.notes: The August 4, 2026 report identifies a recent $2.7 million seed round and $3.1 million total funding. Rivo’s September 7 announcement repeats those amounts; $3.1 million is cumulative, not the seed-round amount. August is the earliest dated public announcement located.

raised_18mo.notes: The seed financing was reported within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No public careers page or live job board was located, so current SDR/BDR/account-executive hiring could not be established.

launched_6mo.notes: The September 7, 2026 announcement explicitly launches Rivo publicly out of beta, within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No dated C-level or VP-level arrival/departure was verified. The team information found does not establish start dates for every C-level leader, so a negative answer is not supported.

crm_stack_signal.notes: No readable job postings, public documentation portal or integrations page was found from which to establish a CRM or sales/marketing system.
